# HeliumSol

> HeliumSol is a full-service digital agency. We design and build full-stack websites, web and mobile apps, AI chatbots and AI assistants, and the n8n workflow automations that run quietly behind them. HeliumSol is a brand of Idea Brothers LLC.

Contact: info@heliumsol.com · +1 (202) 810-7042 · https://heliumsol.com/contact
We reply within one business day. A person reads every enquiry.

## Free offer

A free website, a knowledge-base chatbot and email on the business's own domain, all hosted by HeliumSol. HeliumSol builds the website and a chatbot trained on the business's own content at no charge, sets up professional email on the domain, and hosts everything. Hosting, the chatbot's API usage and the email are included for the first month; after that all three are billed at cost, with the rate confirmed in writing before the month ends. The business buys and owns its domain name. One free website and chatbot per business. No obligation before launch. The signup form never asks for a password.

- [Free website and chatbot signup](https://heliumsol.com/free-website-and-chatbot): the offer terms, what is included, and the signup form.
- [What the free website includes](https://heliumsol.com/free-website-and-chatbot/website): the pages (home, services or products, about, contact with a working enquiry form, privacy policy, extra pages as needed), mobile-first design, fast loading, basic technical SEO, accessibility, analytics with consent, ownership and hand-over criteria.
- [What the free chatbot includes](https://heliumsol.com/free-website-and-chatbot/chatbot): an approved knowledge base, what it can do, the accuracy rules (never invents prices, policies or availability; says when it does not know; hands off to a person), conversational lead capture with confirmation, usage caps and costs.

## Services

- [Full-stack development](https://heliumsol.com/services/full-stack-development): websites and web applications built front to back: design, front end, server, database and integrations. Pages are prerendered so search engines and AI tools read the full content.
- [Mobile app development](https://heliumsol.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps, cross-platform (React Native or Flutter) or native (Swift or Kotlin), with the backend and app store release included.
- [AI chatbots](https://heliumsol.com/services/ai-chatbots): chatbots grounded in a business's own content that answer questions, capture leads and hand off to a person. The assistant on heliumsol.com is one of them.
- [AI assistant solutions](https://heliumsol.com/services/ai-assistant-solutions): assistants that can also look things up and take approved actions (book, log, update) through permissioned, logged tools, with a person in the loop.
- [Workflow automation](https://heliumsol.com/services/workflow-automation): n8n workflows that connect the tools a business already uses, with approvals and alerts where a person should stay involved.
- General tech solutions: if a project involves software, AI or automation and is not listed above, the team is happy to talk it through and say honestly whether it is a fit.

## AI chatbot and assistant use cases

- [AI chatbot for small business](https://heliumsol.com/ai-chatbot-for-small-business): what a chatbot handles for a small team, what it costs to run, how it is set up.
- [AI customer support chatbot](https://heliumsol.com/ai-customer-support-chatbot): grounded answers from documentation, with early handoff to a person.
- [Lead generation chatbot](https://heliumsol.com/lead-generation-chatbot): qualifies one question at a time, captures contact details, routes the lead to inbox or CRM, respects SMS consent rules.
- [AI assistant for your website](https://heliumsol.com/website-ai-assistant): a knowledge-base assistant trained on the site's own content, included free with a new website.

## How working with HeliumSol goes

1. Discovery: we learn your goals, audience, and what success looks like for your business.
2. Design and build: we design, build and refine in short cycles, with you in the loop the whole way.
3. Launch: we ship, test, and make sure everything performs on every device before go-live.
4. Grow: ongoing support, automation and improvements over time.

Pricing and timelines depend on the project and are only given by a person after discovery. HeliumSol does not publish prices and does not guarantee specific results such as leads, sales or revenue. Clients own their code, domains and accounts.
